# pve_storage_files (Data Source)

Lists the files stored on a storage, as reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/content`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_storage_files" "local_iso" {
  node    = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
  content = "iso"
}

output "local_iso_files" {
  value = data.pve_storage_files.local_iso.files
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name through which to address the storage.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier whose content to list.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Only list content of this type. One of the PVE content types: `images`, `rootdir`, `vztmpl`, `iso`, `backup`, `snippets`, `import`. PVE filters the list upstream.

### Read-Only

- `files` (Attributes List) Files on the storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `id` (String) Identifier in `node:storage` form.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `approximate_size` (Number) Approximate volume size in bytes, present instead of `size` for storages with technical limits on exact size; null when the API reports exact `size`.
- `ctime` (Number) Creation time in seconds since the UNIX epoch; null when the API did not report it.
- `encrypted` (String) For encrypted PBS backups, the fingerprint or `1`; null when unencrypted or not a backup.
- `format` (String) Format identifier (`raw`, `qcow2`, `subvol`, `iso`, `tgz`, ...).
- `notes` (String) Optional notes (first line only when multi-line); null when unset.
- `parent` (String) Volume identifier of the parent (for linked clones); null when unset.
- `protected` (Boolean) Protection status (currently only for backups); null when unset.
- `size` (Number) Volume size in bytes; null where the storage cannot determine an exact size and reports `approximate_size` instead.
- `used` (Number) Used space in bytes (most storage plugins report nothing useful here); null when the API did not report it.
- `verification` (Attributes) Last backup verification result, only useful for PBS storages; null when none was reported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files--verification))
- `vmid` (Number) Associated owner VMID; null for unowned files.
- `volid` (String) Volume identifier (e.g. `local:iso/debian-12.iso`).

<a id="nestedatt--files--verification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files.verification`

Read-Only:

- `state` (String) Last backup verification state.
- `upid` (String) Last backup verification UPID.
